purpose: Template for source-backed qualification. Copy to configs/stage15/qualification_17_4ph.json only after each item is reviewed. The template itself never grants calculation permission.

thermodynamic_database_provenance.note: Must address the experimental C15_LAVES deactivation and identify database origin/version/license.

matrix_phase_model.note: Must justify BCC_A2 as the chosen proxy for the intended martensitic state and document limitations.

precipitate_phase_model.note: Must represent the intended Cu-rich precipitation stage, not merely any positive-driving-force phase.

precipitation_sequence_scope.note: State whether the model targets coherent BCC clusters, 9R, FCC epsilon-Cu, or an explicitly calibrated effective phase.

initial_state_and_thermal_history.note: Include solution treatment, cooling history, initial precipitates, retained austenite and aging schedule.

interfacial_energy.note: No Stage 15.2 placeholder may be reused as a material value.

matrix_molar_volume.note: Provide source or derivation at the modeled temperature.

precipitate_molar_volume.note: Must match the selected precipitate representation.

nucleation_site_model.note: Bulk, dislocation, lath/interface or other site model must be justified.

nucleation_site_density.note: Must be consistent with the selected site model.

dislocation_density.note: Required if dislocations influence nucleation or strengthening.

grain_or_lath_size.note: Use the microstructural length scale relevant to the selected model.

elastic_strain_energy_or_justified_omiss.note: Coherent BCC Cu-rich precipitation may require eigenstrain and elastic constants, or a documented reason for omission.

precipitate_shape.note: Sphere, rod, ellipsoid or effective morphology must match the modeled aging stage.

validation_dataset.note: Need time/temperature-resolved particle size, number density, volume fraction and/or hardness data suitable for calibration and validation.

strength_model_inputs.note: Keep strength prediction blocked until shear modulus, Burgers vector and mechanism-specific parameters are independently qualified.
